cover_letter:
Dear Levi Strauss & Co. Hiring Team,

I am writing to enthusiastically apply for the Pure Player Marketing Intern position. As a junior digital marketer with a robust foundation in web design, SEO, and content management, I am eager to contribute my developing skills and proactive approach to your European Pure Player Marketing Team, supporting brand presence and performance across key digital marketplaces.

My current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto involves owning on-page SEO initiatives, crafting keyword-targeted content, and managing client websites from build to maintenance. This experience has honed my ability to improve organic visibility and search rankings while ensuring effective website content management. Furthermore, I regularly track site performance using tools like SEMrush, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console, providing a solid grounding in data review and KPI tracking – skills directly relevant to supporting account leads with campaign performance and assortment reviews.

Beyond my professional role, my personal project, miroook.com, highlights my initiative and passion for digital optimization. I independently designed and built this multi-page WordPress site, integrating on-page SEO and social media. Crucially, I implemented structured data and entity optimization, alongside technical SEO/GEO audits, to enhance visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. This demonstrates a creative approach, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to staying updated with industry best practices, aligning with the innovative spirit required for pure player partnerships.

I am a highly organized, process-driven individual, comfortable operating in fast-paced environments and adept at quickly learning new tools and platforms. My professional English proficiency and B1 Dutch level further support effective communication within an international team. The opportunity to work for Levi Strauss & Co., a globally renowned brand, while gaining invaluable experience in a dynamic and collaborative setting, is incredibly compelling. I am confident my technical acumen, digital marketing experience, and customer-centric mindset will make a valuable contribution to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I have attached my CV for your review and welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Levi Strauss & Co.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
